events.body:
## Context

`public/dashboard.js` (395 lines) isn't loaded by any page since the dashboard was split into `*-page.js` modules. The only reference is an unused `DASHBOARD_JS` constant in `tests/test_frontend_mock_ui.py`.

## What to do

1. `git rm public/dashboard.js`, remove the unused constant, and grep for "dashboard.js".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] /dashboard, /logs, /history and /settings work under `wrangler dev`

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-timer-web
```
